verdicts.reason: Both have the same flaws. The taupe brush-stroke panel that sat behind the title is now orphaned above the text as a meaningless grey shape. 'Spa Utopia' and the subtitle now sit over a busy image, colliding with the amber dropper on the left and the green leaves and capsule on the right. The subtitle is set almost as large as the headline, which flattens the hierarchy, and it runs nearly edge to edge. B is marginally worse because its headline and subtitle are jammed tighter, so Utopia's descenders almost touch 'Weekly'. A leaves slightly more breathing room.
